chapter_name: Chapter 19: Vocabulary Synonyms, Antonyms, and Homophones
learning_objective: 🎯 [Students will expand their vocabulary by identifying words with similar meanings (Synonyms), opposite meanings (Antonyms), and words that sound the same but have different meanings and spellings (Homophones).]
warm_up_hook: 📖 Words are like puzzle pieces! 🧩 Sometimes they mean the exact same thing, sometimes they are complete opposites, and sometimes they play tricks on our ears! Let's become vocabulary masters and unlock the power of words!

lesson_modules.teaching_content: Synonyms are words that have the exact same or very similar meanings. Using synonyms helps make our writing much more interesting so we don't repeat the same words!
Antonyms are words that have completely opposite meanings. They are the 'enemies' in the word world! Sometimes we can make an antonym just by adding 'un-' or 'dis-' to the start of a word.
examples_or_templates: Hot vs. Cold | Fast vs. Slow
Kind vs. Unkind | Agree vs. Disagree

lesson_modules.teaching_content: Homophones are words that SOUND exactly the same when you say them out loud, but they have different spellings and completely different meanings!
examples_or_templates: Sea (the ocean) vs. See (using your eyes)

practice_mcq_quiz.question: ❓ Which of the following is a Synonym for the word 'Begin'?
❓ What is the correct Homophone for 'Two' (the number 2)?

subjective_practice.question: ✍️ Write an Antonym for the word 'Brave'.
subjective_practice.hint: Think of a word that describes someone who is easily scared.

subjective_practice.question: ✍️ Choose the correct Homophone: 'The wind (blue / blew) the leaves away.'
subjective_practice.hint: One is a color, the other is an action from the past.

subjective_practice.question: ✍️ Replace the bold word with a Synonym: 'The puzzle was very **hard**.'
subjective_practice.hint: Think of another word for hard or complicated (starts with 'd').

activity_or_assignment.title: 🌳 The Word Tree
activity_or_assignment.instructions: Draw a large tree. On the left branches, write 5 words and their Synonyms. On the right branches, write 5 words and their Antonyms. Decorate your tree with colorful leaves!

chapter_summary: ⭐ Synonyms are words with the same or similar meanings.
⭐ Antonyms are words with opposite meanings.
⭐ Homophones sound the same but are spelled differently and mean different things.
